summary_md: **polarzero ([@0xpolarzero](https://x.com/0xpolarzero/status/2115965862062768618))** added two mods on top of Claude Code: **lcu**, Codex computer use decoupled for any harness, and **lastdrop**, which uses other AI subscriptions as load-balanced subagents ([amontlabs/lcu](https://github.com/amontlabs/lcu), [amontlabs/lastdrop](https://github.com/amontlabs/lastdrop/)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - amontlabs/lcu: Codex computer use, decoupled from the app, for usage inside any harness.
GitHub - amontlabs/lastdrop: Use any AI subscription as built-in subagents in Claude Code, load-balanced across your accounts.

relevance: Extending a harness with computer use and multi-provider subagents.
